candidates.rule: Set and measure an L1 response-time target, proposed at no more than 10 seconds per message; log tool-call counts and durations, and only expand default context or speed up tools if latency is poor rather than imposing restrictions in advance.
candidates.quote: L1의 목표 응답 시간을 정하고 측정한다 [제안: 메시지당 10초 이내]. 툴 호출 수와 시간을 이벤트로 남긴다.
candidates.harness: Measure and log L1 latency and tool use against the proposed target; do not pre-emptively restrict tool use.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, one short-prompt `claude -p --model haiku` call took about 3 seconds (2.9, 3.1, and 2.9 seconds); the week-7 per-message median was 7 seconds with longer prompts and reasoning, and each tool call adds about that call time.
candidates.quote: 짧은 프롬프트의 `claude -p --model haiku` 한 번이 약 **3초**(2.9, 3.1, 2.9초). 7주차의 메시지당 중앙값 7초
candidates.harness: Use these dated measurements as latency baselines, not guarantees.

candidates.rule: Put information needed for almost every L1 decision in the default context: the current counterpart's `me.counterpart` line, the current unit's cost, grade, and expiry, and the category price range, so most decisions need zero or one tool call.
candidates.quote: 이번 상대의 `me.counterpart` 줄, 이번 유닛의 원가·등급·유통기한, 이 카테고리의 가격대
candidates.harness: Include those facts in the L1 context and reserve tool calls for additional information.

candidates.rule: On the first day, compare L1 using Claude Code's own tool loop with the other approach, allowing only the harness's MCP tools and not reading project settings; choose based on response time and decision quality.
candidates.quote: 첫날 두 방식의 응답 시간과 판단 품질을 비교해 정한다.
candidates.harness: Run and compare both approaches on the first day before selecting one.

candidates.rule: On the first day, measure calls and quota failures by role. If capacity is tight, report each step in the briefing and degrade in this order: move review and forum to OpenRouter, set analysis cadence to 4 hours, use `sonnet` for strategy, then move buyer bargaining to OpenRouter; keep L1 seller on Claude Code until the final fallback.
candidates.quote: 빠듯하면 아래 순서로 내린다. 각 단계는 브리핑에 보고한다.
candidates.harness: Measure role-level usage and quota failures, follow the stated degradation order, and report each change.

candidates.rule: Run every model call from an empty folder with `claude -p --model <m> --tools "" --setting-sources ""`; because seller and buyer share an account, limit concurrent calls and prioritize L1.
candidates.quote: 가게와 buyer가 같은 계정을 쓰므로 호출 관리자가 동시 호출을 제한하고 **L1을 우선**한다.
candidates.harness: Use the specified isolated invocation and enforce concurrency limits with L1 priority.

candidates.rule: Schedule calls in this priority order: L1 seller and buyer, strategy, analysis, then forum and review; defer lower-priority calls when capacity is tight. If L1 hits a quota, use a cheap OpenRouter model and log `[model] fallback`.
candidates.quote: 호출 관리자의 우선순위: L1 seller·buyer → 전략 → 분석 → forum·review.
candidates.harness: Apply the priority order, defer lower-priority work, and record L1 fallback.

candidates.rule: Keep the OpenRouter key only in the user's `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` environment variable; never write it to the repository, logs, or memory, and set a credit limit on the key.
candidates.quote: 저장소, 로그, 메모리에 쓰지 않는다 (AGENTS.md). 키에는 크레딧 한도를 건다.
candidates.harness: Protect the key and configure a credit cap.

candidates.rule: For every call, record role, model, response time, tokens, cost, and failure, aggregate results with `eval.decision_quality`, and reconsider model placement using first-day measurements.
candidates.quote: 모든 호출에 자리, 모델, 응답 시간, 토큰, 비용, 실패를 남기고 `eval.decision_quality`로 집계한다.
candidates.harness: Log the required fields and use the first-day measurements to revise placement.

candidates.rule: For L1 prompts, prioritize clearly conveying the role over minimizing tokens; target about 2,000 tokens for the card (seller about 1,930) and about 4,000 tokens for the full prompt including tools and current context. Measure cache fit and latency on the first day and shorten only if needed.
candidates.quote: 역할을 분명히 전하는 것이 토큰보다 중요하다.
candidates.harness: Stay near the stated prompt targets, measure first, and reduce only when necessary.

candidates.rule: Order prompts from stable to changing content: system card, role, tool descriptions, current priorities, then current situation. Avoid frequent card changes because they rebuild the cache; measure cache fit on the first day.
candidates.quote: 시스템 카드 → 역할 → 툴 설명 → 지금의 우선순위 → 이번 상황.
candidates.harness: Build prompts in that order and track cache fit.

candidates.rule: After three consecutive Claude Code quota failures for a role, for example, stop that role's calls for about five minutes and route to OpenRouter; make one test call during the pause, restore the route after recovery, and record breaker changes and recovery in `[model] breaker` and `bus/status/inner.json`. Do not route non-L1 roles to OpenRouter; defer them instead.
candidates.quote: 자리마다 Claude Code 한도 실패가 연속되면(예: 3번) 그 자리의 호출을 일정 시간(예: 5분) 끊고 OpenRouter로 돌린다.
candidates.harness: Implement the breaker, recovery test, and required records; defer non-L1 calls instead of rerouting them.

candidates.rule: The evaluation weights are 40% for the model criterion, 30% for structural originality, and 30% for ranking.
candidates.harness: Use the stated weights when evaluating the design.

candidates.rule: The required basic condition is 20 settlements each.
candidates.quote: | 기본 조건 | – | 정산 각 20건.
candidates.harness: Track settlements and verify that each reaches 20.

candidates.rule: Deterministic evaluation metrics are calculated by evaluation tools and must return the same value regardless of who calls them.
candidates.quote: 결정론적인 지표는 평가 툴(3.3)이 계산한다. 누가 불러도 같은 값이 나온다.
candidates.harness: Compute deterministic metrics through shared evaluation tools.

candidates.rule: An execution agent (L1) must not evaluate itself; it may read only evaluations needed for its next decision. For example, a buyer reads prior payment-decline reasons before ordering, and restock reads sales of SKUs it purchased.
candidates.quote: 실행 에이전트(L1)는 스스로를 평가하지 않는다.
candidates.harness: Prevent L1 from self-evaluating and expose relevant prior evaluations for its next decision.

candidates.rule: Judgment-based evaluation is assigned outward: execution is evaluated by self-analysis, analysis by strategy and audit, and strategy by audit and the user.
candidates.quote: 판단이 필요한 평가는 바깥 에이전트가 한다.
candidates.harness: Route judgment-based evaluations to the stated evaluators rather than the evaluated agent.

candidates.rule: Include evaluation results in two-hour summaries and use them in briefing sections ① and ③.
candidates.quote: 평가 결과는 2시간 조각 요약에 들어가고, 브리핑 ①③에 쓰인다.
candidates.harness: Add evaluation results to the two-hour summaries and specified briefing sections.

candidates.rule: Evaluate seller outcomes with `eval.unit_economics`, `eval.funnel`, and `eval.score` for net profit, revenue, and rating; evaluate process with `eval.decision_quality`, `eval.integrity` for the share of true claims, and `eval.guess_accuracy`. Self-analysis judges why customers left and whether the seller used its stance well.
candidates.quote: `eval.unit_economics`, `eval.funnel`, `eval.score`의 순이익·매출·별점
candidates.harness: Calculate the listed metrics and route the judgment-based questions to seller self-analysis.

candidates.rule: Evaluate buyer outcomes with `eval.unit_economics` for surplus, `eval.funnel`, and `eval.losses` for cap and breakdown losses; evaluate process with `eval.decision_quality` and `eval.integrity` for receipt checking. Self-analysis judges whether the buyer chose shops well and negotiated effectively.
candidates.quote: `eval.unit_economics`(잉여), `eval.funnel`, `eval.losses`(상한·고장)
candidates.harness: Calculate the listed metrics and route the judgment-based questions to buyer self-analysis.

candidates.rule: Evaluate restock outcomes with `eval.stock_health`, `eval.losses`, and `eval.unit_economics` for net-profit contribution; evaluate process with `eval.decision_quality` and comparison against the default using `eval.stock_health`. Self-analysis and strategy judge what should have been purchased more.
candidates.quote: `eval.stock_health`, `eval.losses`, `eval.unit_economics`(순이익 기여)
candidates.harness: Calculate the listed metrics and send the purchasing judgment to self-analysis and strategy.

candidates.rule: Evaluate review outcomes with counterpart-shop rating change and our shop's percentile via `eval.score`; assess process using `eval.integrity` for review numbers versus facts, differences from `calc.fact_stars` and whether reasons were recorded, and missed reviews. Self-analysis and audit judge whether deviations from fact-based stars helped relations or ranking and how recipients reacted.
candidates.quote: 상대 가게 별점 변화와 우리 가게 백분위 (`eval.score`)
candidates.harness: Track the outcome and process measures and assign the stated judgment-based review to self-analysis and audit.

candidates.rule: Evaluate forum activity with `eval.forum` and reference integrity with `eval.integrity` on `refs`; self-analysis and audit judge whether posts are useful and honest under P8.
candidates.quote: `eval.forum`
candidates.harness: Calculate the listed metrics and route the content judgment to self-analysis and audit.

candidates.rule: Evaluate market analysis process with `eval.guess_accuracy`, summary freshness, and whether actual changes follow a profile's `changed` marker; strategy and audit judge whether profile interpretation was correct.
candidates.quote: `eval.guess_accuracy`, 요약 신선도, 프로필 `changed` 뒤 실제 변화 여부
candidates.harness: Track these measures and assign interpretation review to strategy and audit.

candidates.rule: Evaluate self-analysis process by tracking missing metrics and whether alerts were correct; strategy and audit judge whether the cause analysis was correct.
candidates.quote: 지표 누락, 경보가 맞았나
candidates.harness: Track omissions and alert accuracy, and route cause-analysis review to strategy and audit.

candidates.rule: Evaluate strategy outcomes with score changes from `eval.score` and process with `eval.experiment` and `eval.proposals`; audit and the user judge whether the reasoning was sound.
candidates.quote: `eval.score`의 변화
candidates.harness: Calculate the listed metrics and route reasoning review to audit and the user.

candidates.rule: Evaluate audits with `eval.audits`; the user judges whether the audits were useful.
candidates.quote: `eval.audits`
candidates.harness: Record audit evaluations and expose them for user review.

candidates.rule: Evaluate the whole system with `eval.score` and the basic condition, and use system-scope `eval.decision_quality` for L1 uptime and account quota conflicts.
candidates.quote: `eval.decision_quality`(scope=system): L1 가동률, 계정 한도 충돌
candidates.harness: Track system score, settlement conditions, L1 uptime, and quota conflicts.

candidates.rule: As of 2026-11-03, lookup, calculation, validation, and evaluation tools numbered 25 and shared a common contract, but execution tools, recording tools, memory tools, and the MCP server were still unimplemented.
candidates.quote: 조회·계산·검증·평가 툴 25개와 공통 계약. 실행(`act.*`)·기록(`rec.*`)·`memory.*`·MCP는 아직
candidates.harness: Treat those tool groups as incomplete as of the stated date.

candidates.rule: As of 2026-11-03, the first three implementation stages were complete, execution agents were coded and locally checked, forum execution testing awaited board data, and stages 5–8 remained.
candidates.harness: Use the dated status to distinguish completed work from pending work.

candidates.rule: Local A2A checks recorded two seller bargaining turns, a buyer-seller trade in 60 seconds, restock in 38 seconds, and a five-star review in 12 seconds; model responses varied from 4 to 60 seconds, requiring first-day measurement.
candidates.quote: 모델 응답이 4초에서 60초까지 튄다: 첫날 측정
candidates.harness: Treat the timings as local observations, measure latency on the first day, and do not assume stable response times.
